objective: Implement the independent benchmark result schema, validator and deterministic scorer portion of approved T13

acceptance.text: Schema and validator require two explicitly identified configurations with the same story/base and consistent measured gate/review/retry metrics; unavailable tokens/cost remain null.
Scoring is deterministic, reports meaningful ties/no eligible winner and never recommends failed or gate/review-blocked runs; rendering handles untrusted labels without altering output structure.
Import and CLI tests prove no provider calls, Git changes or import-time side effects; fixture tests cover valid, invalid and unavailable measurements.
